# Optional Web backend dependencies

The Web backend links system Boost.System/Boost.JSON and the system libjpeg API;
Beast/Asio are Boost headers. These dependencies are not required by Desktop-only
or plain Headless builds. The browser assets are project-owned vanilla JS/CSS/HTML.

## Boost

Boost.Beast/Asio, Boost.System, Boost.JSON and transitive Boost.Container use the
[Boost Software License 1.0](https://www.boost.org/LICENSE_1_0.txt). The asynchronous
server design was informed by the official Beast examples (Vinnie Falco,
Copyright 2016–2019); server implementation types remain private.

## JPEG

Tested with libjpeg-turbo 2.1.5's libjpeg API (IJG-compatible interface).

**This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.**

libjpeg-turbo's applicable licenses are IJG, BSD-3-Clause and zlib; retain the
notices supplied with the particular system package when redistributing it.
See its [license/compliance guidance](https://github.com/libjpeg-turbo/libjpeg-turbo/blob/main/LICENSE.md).
No codec source is vendored here. Fatal codec errors are contained in a C wrapper;
no longjmp crosses C++ destructors.

## Development tests only

Playwright (Apache-2.0) and its downloaded Chromium browser are development test
tools, not library/runtime or served-asset dependencies. Their package notices
remain in the npm/browser installation. No Playwright video recording or FFmpeg
encoding is used by this project.
